outcome: A story on the roadmap now has to say what it is: the three routes that author stories refuse one that omits its epic, narrative, acceptance criteria, skill or an explicit depends_on. Two new commands make that requirement satisfiable after sign-off — roadmap epic add creates an epic, set-epic points an existing story at one — and this repo's own roadmap was backfilled through them, so forge roadmap list finally prints its epic above the stories. Legacy roadmaps still load, still flip status and still heal; doctor reports their gaps without blocking, and no longer crashes on the broken state it exists to diagnose.
